rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No hits on banned terms (honest, delve, landscape-verb, importantly, crucial, substrate, leverage-verb, synergize, paradigm shift). No em-dashes in body. Register term 'discipline' used appropriately throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'ritual', 'ceremony', or 'practice' (noun) in body. Word 'discipline' carries meaning without ceremony register.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body contains no retrospective markers, dated session references, or transition verbs (moved, renamed, extracted). Prose reads as present-tense state throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body demonstrates deliberate quintet mix: Boris-flat on 'Nobody reviews 500K lines by hand' (technical precision). Rory reframe on 'How do you know it's right?' (counterintuitive close). Risto optimism on 'The agentic engineer maxes that signal out' (forward action). Martin logical-strategic in transition structure ('the quality arc', 'the discipline has gone deeper'). Peer-warm Godin in 'Every push-back, every correction, every "no, like this"'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule applies to article drafts. This is finished lecture prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Dex Horthy credited inline. Clean Code reference carries both link and attribution. No unattributed practitioner technique.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student".
rules_evaluated.evidence: Primary address: 'You ship a million lines of new stuff' (proper second person). 'The agentic engineer maxes that signal out' = documented carve-out per maintainer: 'module-as-subject phrasing kept (Sutherland-flip off the student, per check_student_facing rule 3)'. This is intentional Sutherland-flip, not violation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'grounding' earned in body: 'Beyond spec-and-tests, toward human signal. Every push-back, every correction, every "no, like this" is signal of something: what's true, what's valuable, what works, what's broken.' 'Decay' earned through entire Decay section. 'Discipline' established throughout. No maintainer-only vocabulary leaks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance shapes (it's OK if, fine way to, no penalty, not a downgrade). Body states discipline and stakes directly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reference artifacts or user-specified frames in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Dex Horthy named once in body prose. Meets cap.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closing 'How do you know it's right?' holds punch without hedge. No softening applied.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + strategy docs, NOT body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body teaches quality arc through narrative, not defensive positioning. No phrases like 'not an aspirational X', 'grounded in actual', 'unlike consultancy'. Clean Code citation appears educational, not marketing-shaped.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'grounding' earned at point of introduction. M1/M2/M3/M5 arc references kept per maintainer carve-out. No premature jargon planting.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No forcing function trimmed; all prose reaches closure cleanly. No dangling pronouns or demonstratives with ambiguous referents.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Past tense for exercise recap sections.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture stakes-setter, not exercise recap. Tense rule does not apply.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No combative verbs (bark, order, command, whip, force, drag). Verbs are peer-flat or warmer: 'learned against', 'advises', 'carries', 'maxes'. Agent framing cooperative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Five moves, one quality discipline' — accurate enumeration and theme. 'Decay clears the gate' — decay IS what fast checks miss, clearing gate's blindspot. 'From spec-and-tests to grounding' — body documents this progression literally. No spatial metaphors contradicting mechanism.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negations, no deictic drumroll, no bold-label echo, no citation duplication. All four shapes absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Five moves, one discipline' appears in flowing prose narrative, not as numeral preceding visible bulleted list. Count functions as memory handle across arc (discipline is 'one, not one per module'), passing carve-out test.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Nobody reviews 500K lines by hand' — hyperbolic but true in essence. '500K in weeks' — sourced to maintainer-attested event. No superlatives fail truth test.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file evaluation; no sibling files in judgment scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file evaluation; sweep-caching does not apply.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body names aspiration: 'You ship a million lines' (forward possibility), 'agentic engineer maxes signal out' (ideal outcome). No corrective framing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'grounding' earned: 'Beyond spec-and-tests, toward human signal. Every push-back, every correction, every "no, like this" is signal of something: what's true, what's valuable, what works, what's broken.' M1/M2/M3/M5 abbreviations earned as curriculum convention by M6.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: No banned jargon (substrate, leverage, synergize, paradigm shift, consultancy register). Clean register throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Neither term used in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No troubleshooting or recovery branches. Stakes-setter lecture only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No prompt in this lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No debrief or retro content.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Voice maintains M6 stakes-setter register throughout. No M1 joy, M4 testing mode, M5 long-run drift, or M7 closure leakage.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No manual error-catching ask in this lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No self-study simulation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No research-box callouts. Citations embedded in narrative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No student move or prompt in this lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: CLAUDE.md not referenced.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No em-dashes. Sentences split cleanly on commas or periods.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture headers are declarative noun-phrases ('Five moves', 'Decay clears the gate', 'From spec-and-tests to grounding'), exempt per rule text. Reader's job is understanding, not doing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Why software factories fail' (title, not path). 'Clean Code Is Steering: Reading Uncle Bob's Agent Experiments' (title, not path). No backticks or filenames in link text.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No student-authored-write moment. No contested word (memory/skill/rule/plan/agent/subagent) at first-write point.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'the verifier advises the agent' — agent correctly used for autonomous work. 'Coding models' used for thinking-side discussion. No conflation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session / task / run split.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Session/task/run vocabulary not used in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'fall 2025' is season-band event date, not time-of-day anchor. Allowed per rule text as dated-historical context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No labeled reflection ('Pause before', 'Meta-moment', 'Step back') or contemplative prefixes ('sit with', 'let it land', 'breathe'). Question and action carry reflection without pedagogy-aware framing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No fenced prompts in this lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No artifact-save instruction in this lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every sentence moves understanding forward toward grounding concept. No implementation details before use, no administrative asides, no extra source trivia. All content advances arc.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body "read it" / "look at it" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No chat-print artifacts in lecture body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closing: 'You ship a million lines of new stuff. How do you know it's right?' Student ('You') as grammatical subject throughout. No audience-shift to different role.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No operational setting (thinking-effort, model choice, mode tag, worktree path) referenced in this lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body uses house vocabulary: 'discipline' (earned theory term), 'gates' (M1+ forward), 'checks' (M1 earned), 'loop' (M1 earned). No invented synonyms competing with theory spine.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No agent-direction prose. No 'typing continue', 'tell it to', 'saying to Claude'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the outcome; don't walk professional through trivial mechanics.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No setup instructions or terminal recipes. Body focuses on concepts, not mechanics.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body describes quality discipline arc, not training shape. No 'later module...', 'training covers...', 'together they map...' sentences. Subject test: all sentences about student's work, agent's work, or discipline. No meta-cartography.
